quantisation: degrees * 1000, rounded to int (3 dp, ~110 m); divide by scale to get degrees. Rings are also Douglas-Peucker simplified with eps=0.002 deg (~220 m) before quantising
ring_format: flat scaled-int array [x0,y0,dx1,dy1,dx2,dy2,...]: first pair absolute (lon,lat), every later pair a delta from the previous point. Rings are implicitly closed (last point != first). All rings of a country are tested together with the even-odd rule, so interior holes are plain rings
subunits_source: Natural Earth 5.x admin-0 map units, 10m (public domain)
subunits_note: overseas territories that admin-0 folds into their parent state but that have their own ISO code and their own emergency numbers. Same object shape and encoding as `countries`. Lookup order: test `subunits` first, fall back to `countries`
